messages:
incident-bot: ALERT P1: High tail latency for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (p50 220ms, p95 1.8s, p99 4.7s). Paging oncall @Maya Chen :rotating_light:
Maya Chen: I'm on it. Can someone grab recent deploys?
Samir Patel: No prod deploys in the last 2 hours from CI. Saw a spike in request concurrency around 11:04 UTC.
Riley O'Connor: Looking at load balancer — backend instance pool shows increasing queue depth on worker-gpu-03.
Ben Walker: I see repeated KV-cache misses from the same model shard, probably caused by a cold restart earlier. Logs show a restart at 10:59 but healthchecks passed.
Maya Chen: Good catch. Can we mitigate quickly — reduce batching on that pool and failover to pool-b?
Alice Gomez: I'll flip routing to prefer pool-b for read traffic and throttle new long-running requests. Pushing config change now.
ops-runner (system): deploy: route-weight-update applied to model-routing (pool-a -> pool-b shift 70/30).
Samir Patel: After routing change p95 dropped to 1.1s, p99 2.4s. Still not at baseline.
Riley O'Connor: Noted. There are 3 hosts in pool-b with older quantized model variant. CPU-bound but lower latency for short seqs. Might increase errors for long sequences.
Maya Chen: Prioritize customer impact: any recent errors surfaced to customers? Any 5xx spikes?
Ben Walker: 5xx count up 0.3% -> 1.2% during spike, mainly timeout errors upstream. No major customer-facing 500 pages reported yet; support ticket queue empty for this window.
Alice Gomez: I'm enabling aggressive prefix caching for common prompts to reduce repeated KV population. Applying cache TTL 10m for top-100 prompts.
Samir Patel: Cache change live. Latency p95: 0.9s, p99: 1.6s. Good.
Maya Chen: Reassess paging rules: incident lasted ~20m with mitigations. Post-incident we need retro + dashboard changes to surface root cause faster and avoid noisy alerts.
Riley O'Connor: Agreed. Current dashboards don't show cross-pool queue depth and per-shard KV-miss rate simultaneously — that made correlation slow.
Ben Walker: Propose new Grafana panels for retros: 
- Golden signals: overall request rate, error rate (5xx), latency (p50/p95/p99) by route.
- Pool health matrix: queue depth, GPU utilization, active KV-cache miss rate per pool.
- Model-shard hotness: KV-population churn, last-restart, and cache hit ratio with drilldown links to logs/traces.
Maya Chen: Also add a Pagerflow panel: map of routing weights + recent weigh-change events so oncall sees if routing flips correlate with latency.
Alice Gomez: For drilldowns: each panel should link to a dedicated dashboard that pre-filters by pool and model-shard and open corresponding distributed trace search and logs explorer. Example link pattern: /dash/db/detail?pool={{pool}}&shard={{shard}}
Samir Patel: Example Grafana query for per-shard KV miss rate (Prometheus):
```
sum by (shard) (rate(model_kv_miss_total[1m])) / sum by (shard) (rate(model_kv_request_total[1m]))
```
Riley O'Connor: And queue depth per pool:
```
sum by (pool) (gpu_request_queue_length)
```
Maya Chen: Good. Let's capture actionable thresholds too; not just raw metrics. Suggest alert rules: 
- kv_miss_rate per shard > 0.15 for 5m -> page SRE (indicates cache thrashing)
- pool_queue_depth > 50 requests for 2m -> page ops (backlog)
- p99 latency > 3s for 3m -> page SRE and product-led Slack channel for visibility
Ben Walker: We should label alerts with runbook links and rollout owners. Also add a silencing policy when a routing weight change is in progress to avoid duplicate pages.
Alice Gomez: I'll open a dashboard PR with new panels and alert templates. Assigning myself to implement initial layout + drilldown scaffolding.
Maya Chen: I'll author the post-incident note with timeline and customer impact summary. We'll include the decision to add the panels and the new threshold proposals.
Samir Patel: Action items: 
- Alice: Grafana panel PR + example queries + drilldown links (owner: Alice)
- Ben: Update alerting rules and add silencing policy for routing ops (owner: Ben)
- Riley: Instrument additional KV-miss metrics per shard and emit last-restart timestamps (owner: Riley)
- Maya: Post-incident note and runbook updates (owner: Maya)
Alice Gomez: ETA for PR: 48 hours. Will include screenshots and JSON snippets for panels.
Ben Walker: ETA for alert rule changes: 24 hours (will coordinate with oncall window).
Riley O'Connor: Instrumentation PR: 72 hours (needs minor runtime changes).
Maya Chen: Handoff to follow-up oncall @Samir Patel in 30m. If anything flares up I'm reachable.
Samir Patel: Taking follow-up. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: latency returned to baseline; incident duration ~35m. Close page and file retro within 72h.
